_comment: Template config for run_barcode_pipeline.py. Copy this folder to run_configs/<your_run_name>/, edit config.json, then run: python run_barcode_pipeline.py run_configs/<your_run_name>/config.json. This is plain JSON (no comments allowed in the real file) -- see README.md in this folder for what each field means.
_barcode_read_comment: "R1" (default, omit entirely for the normal case) or "R2" for a run where read orientation was swapped -- applies to every sample in this run (never mixed within one run). Drives both the stage_fastqs filenames below and the reverse-complement step. See README.md.
_assume_tag_present_comment: false (default): a read whose tag window doesn't confidently fuzzy-match any declared tag gets bc_offset=0 (no skip) -- correct when some reads genuinely have no tag at that position (e.g. a tag-less ladder/spike-in mixed in with tagged samples). true: skip the tag window unconditionally regardless of match confidence -- use this when every real read in this sample is known to carry a tag at that fixed position with no genuinely tag-less population; otherwise a noisy (but present) tag read silently shifts/truncates the reported barcode instead of being correctly offset, which can fabricate many spurious distinct barcodes. See README.md.
